title: Fractal Lease FL-1: A Consensus-Enforced Timelock Lease on a Bitcoin Fraction, with Owner Recovery via the First Taproot Script-Path Spend in the SQUIRL OS Program
description:
Fractal Lease FL-1: a complete lease-and-recovery cycle on a single fractal-tokenized Bitcoin fraction — authority leased to a fresh key under consensus-enforced timelock (taproot script tree), recovered by the owner via the program's first taproot script-path (tapscript) spend, confirmed in blocks 972370/972382. Dual-layer enforcement: BTC script tree as vault, XRP escrow as courtroom; sub-cent carrier attestation on XRP and Stellar. Full honest defect trail disclosed, including a BIP342 draft-vs-final SigMsg library defect found by node rejection. Version 1.0, 2026-10-20, authored by Leon Calvin Long II (ORCID 0009-0002-1140-9568).

Related: FT-1 Fractal Tokenization (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23510677); IP-013 constant-footprint corpus commitment (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23491295); program benchmark (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23321637).

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects on them.
